records.rationale: T5's contemporaneous operating-partner announcement identifies Digital Crossroad's DX-1 facility in Hammond and gives its October 31, 2020 launch date, 20 MW of critical power, and 108,000 square feet. Hammond's current official record independently identifies the existing 105,000-square-foot data center at the Digital Crossroads site. The small area difference is treated as reported gross-area variation and is not normalized here.

raw_value.label: DX-1 launch scheduled for October 31, 2020 with T5 facility-management services

evidence.finding: The operating partner identifies the exact Hammond campus, facility name, launch date, capacity, and facility-management role.

raw_value.value: Hammond's current 105,000-square-foot data center at Digital Crossroads

evidence.finding: The city independently confirms that the existing Hammond facility remains a current data center.

events.notes: T5's contemporaneous announcement supplies the stated DX-1 launch date. The event establishes operation of the exact mapped Digital Crossroad facility no later than October 31, 2020.

records.rationale: Sourcewell's executed public master agreement identifies AngelTrax at 119 South Woodburn Drive in Dothan and states that AngelTrax provides cloud hosting from its own SOC 2 Type II-compliant data center with access limited to its data-center team. This establishes an operating AngelTrax data center at the mapped headquarters no later than the agreement's April 22, 2025 effective date.

raw_value.label: AngelTrax provides active cloud hosting in its own SOC 2 Type II-compliant data center

evidence.finding: The local-government cooperative contract identifies the operator, Dothan headquarters, active hosting service, dedicated servers, backups, and restricted data-center operations team.

events.notes: Operational no later than the effective date of the public agreement describing AngelTrax's active Dothan-hosted data-center service.

records.rationale: Windstream's contemporaneous release announces the opening of its new 30,000-square-foot Little Rock data center on April 12, 2012. The address, facility scale, and later TierPoint identity align with the exact mapped TierPoint Little Rock facility.

raw_value.label: Windstream opened its new Little Rock data center

evidence.finding: The predecessor operator supplies a contemporaneous exact-city opening, facility size, operating features, and grand-opening schedule.

events.notes: Windstream announced the new Little Rock facility open on April 12, 2012; the formal opening ceremony followed on April 19.

records.rationale: The City of Searcy's current Information Technology page identifies the IT Building at 107 North Elm and describes its protected NOC, redundant cooling, emergency generation, server farm, storage arrays, and automated backups. This is the exact mapped municipal facility. Because the page is undated, September 1, 2026 is an observation-date anchor rather than a claimed commissioning date.

raw_value.label: Current municipal NOC, server farm, and data center at 107 North Elm

evidence.finding: The city directly identifies current data-center infrastructure and operations at the mapped Information Technology Building.

events.notes: Operational no later than the September 1, 2026 research observation. The page does not publish a commissioning date, so this is an observation anchor only.

records.rationale: The point coordinates resolve to e360's former headquarters at Suite 730, 1855 Gateway Boulevard. e360 identifies the location as its prior corporate headquarters, and the building owner identifies 1855 Gateway as one of two ten-story Class A office towers. e360 is an IT consultancy whose services include data-center transformation; neither source supports a data-center facility at this point. The seed is rejected as a company-office false positive.

raw_value.value: e360 relocated its corporate headquarters from Concord to Irvine effective July 1, 2025

evidence.finding: The named entity at the mapped point is e360's former corporate office, not a published data-center operation.
The property owner identifies 1855 Gateway Boulevard as a multi-tenant Class A office tower.

records.rationale: Kaiser Permanente's October 24, 2011 release identifies its Napa data center as an operating facility whose cooling-efficiency project had already generated measured energy and cost savings and received a 2010-2011 Energy Star rating. The facility identity and Napa location align with the exact mapped Kaiser building.

raw_value.label: Operating Napa data center with measured cooling-efficiency results

evidence.finding: The operator release identifies active Napa data-center operations and completed efficiency work by October 24, 2011.

events.notes: Operational no later than the operator's dated release documenting completed efficiency work and an existing Energy Star rating at the Napa data center.

records.rationale: La Sierra University's official campus map expands the mapped label IT as Information Technology, and the university's IT page identifies the location as the IT Modular/Annex and a help-desk office. Neither source describes a purpose-built data-center facility. The OpenStreetMap data-center tag conflates a university department abbreviation with a data center, so the seed is rejected as a false positive.

raw_value.value: Campus building code IT means Information Technology

evidence.finding: The university's own map resolves the ambiguous IT label to its Information Technology department rather than a data-center facility.

raw_value.value: Information Technology help desk at IT Modular/Annex and Ambs Hall

evidence.finding: The department page identifies an office and support function at the mapped location and publishes no data-center operation.

records.rationale: Digital West's contemporaneous April 24, 2013 release, issued from 3620 Sacramento Drive, reports completion of an independent SOC 2 examination focused on its data-center and colocation controls. The operator, address, and service description align with the mapped Digital West point and establish operation no later than the release date.

raw_value.label: Operating carrier-neutral data center with audited controls

evidence.finding: The exact-address operator release documents an operating San Luis Obispo data center and completed controls audit.

events.notes: Operational no later than Digital West's dated release documenting completion of a SOC 2 examination of the exact-address data-center and colocation operation.

records.rationale: BKF Engineers identifies an existing PG&E data center at the exact 425 Beck Avenue address and documents cooling, utility, resilience, and efficiency upgrades. PG&E's CPUC testimony supplies the same 425 Beck business address and states that its witness managed Data Center Facilities and led a significant retrofit beginning within his 2006-2016 tenure. Together the records establish the mapped facility operating no later than 2006, with year precision.

raw_value.label: Existing PG&E data center at 425 Beck Avenue

evidence.finding: The engineering project page maps PG&E data-center infrastructure and active resilience work to the exact governed address.

raw_value.value: 425 Beck business address; managed Data Center Facilities and retrofit work during 2006-2016

evidence.finding: The sworn regulatory testimony supplies the earliest reviewed year anchor, although it does not state a commissioning date.

events.notes: Operational no later than 2006 based on the witness's 425 Beck address and stated 2006-2016 data-center-facilities management and retrofit responsibilities, corroborated by BKF's exact-address project record.

records.rationale: Yosemite Community College District's official Measure E project record identifies the exact Modesto Junior College West Campus Primary Data Center, marks the project complete, and gives a Fall 2013 opening. It also states that the new facility replaced an existing West Campus data center that had exceeded its functional life.

raw_value.label: Complete Primary Data Center opened Fall 2013

evidence.finding: The district directly identifies the mapped project, completion status, West Campus location, and opening season.

events.notes: Opened in Fall 2013; the governed temporal model records the event at year precision because season precision is not supported.

records.rationale: A February 1, 2007 SEC-filed lease identifies 12396 Grant Street as a building then used by DoubleClick as a critical data-center facility and leases equipped data-center space to Epsilon. EPA's 2008 compliance order independently maps DoubleClick and successor Google to the exact address. These records establish the mapped Thornton facility operating no later than February 1, 2007.

raw_value.label: Building presently used as a critical data center facility

evidence.finding: The executed lease states the exact-address building was already in critical data-center use and details racks, power distribution, cooling, cabling, and security.

raw_value.value: DoubleClick facility at 12396 Grant Street, Thornton, Colorado

evidence.finding: The federal order independently confirms the operator and exact facility address after Google's acquisition of DoubleClick.

events.notes: Operational no later than the execution date of the exact-address lease describing the building's present critical data-center use.

raw_value.label: 22,137 square feet of operating data-center space at 1275 K Street

records.rationale: FamilySearch's official location page identifies the mapped 661 Washington Street building as the Bear Lake Idaho FamilySearch Center, a public genealogy-research facility with limited hours, volunteers, computers, internet, and access to family-history records. raw_value.value: FamilySearch centers provide genealogy help and public access to computers, internet, and records
